legacy.claim: Under the standard Poisson operator, \(\Phi_{\rm lag}\) has \(\nabla^2\Phi\neq0\) outside the compact matter source, corresponding at first order to an effective dipolar density \(\propto\cos\theta/R^3\) whose dipole moment diverges linearly with box radius
legacy.evidence: Same section; analytic calculation plus an uncataloged finite-difference check. This excludes a compact-source Poisson-vacuum interpretation, not every possible local substrate equation
